_meta: A two-turn conversation feeding a retrieval system. Turn 1 (the user asks 'Tell me about the Falcon 9 rocket') establishes the entity the conversation is about; history_terms are the entity keywords carried from that turn: falcon, 9, rocket. Turn 2 is a FOLLOW-UP: 'How much does it cost per launch?' -- its content keywords (follow_up_terms) are just cost, launch, because the entity is referred to only by the pronoun 'it'. Retrieval on the raw follow-up therefore has no entity term to match, so it cannot tell the Falcon-9-specific cost document from a generic rocket-cost document. Conversational query rewriting resolves the pronoun by merging the history entity terms into the follow-up, producing a self-contained query (falcon, 9, rocket, cost, launch) that retrieves the right document. documents maps each doc id to its keyword set; scoring is keyword overlap. history_terms, follow_up_terms, and documents are the fixture; every query, score, and ranking is computed.
